manifest.external_scope: Unmodified original source tasks only. Replay all returned finite policies. Report verified worst-case depth and bounded feasibility, without assuming optimality.
manifest.overlay: Every non-observing action consumes one actuation unit; each Boolean observation consumes one sensor unit. These budget overlays are NOT original benchmark constraints.
manifest.projection_selection: Fixed schema predicates, no solution or performance feedback. Common current projection is checked at query time. Static facts remain model-specific constraints.
manifest.timing: Isolated processes, fixed CPU affinity when available; all construction/search timed. Worker module import separately reported. One run, no significance claims.
